**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **main** branch:

**preserve selectable for aliased() of aliased CTE, subquery** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/6964

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **rel_2_0** branch:

**preserve selectable for aliased() of aliased CTE, subquery** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/6965

**Mike Bayer** referenced this issue:

**alias of an aliased CTE refers to the original CTE** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/6968

**Mike Bayer** referenced this issue:

**don't embed anonymous names in flat named join alias** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/6969

Thanks, @zzzeek - much appreciated, as always. My workaround, given that I have the filtered table aliased in my system, which works with both subquery and cte, is:

```
gpo_sel = Group.filter_open()._aliased_insp.selectable
gp1 = aliased(Group, gpo_sel.alias("gp1"))
gp2 = aliased(Group, gpo_sel.alias("gp2"))
```

Needless to say, I'm glad you're fixing it!
